messages:
Elaine (Docs): Quick sync — opened a PR to unify terminology across docs + SDK snippets. Need eyes on voice/tone and the API naming mapping. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Jordan (Eng-API): Thanks — skimmed it. Small nit: we currently use 'model variant' in the runtime docs but a few pages say 'model flavor' — we should pick one (recommend 'model variant').
Priya (Product): +1 on 'model variant'. Also: our voice blurb should be explicit — 'direct, helpful, engineering-first'. Avoid marketing phrasing in examples.
Sam (DevEx): I can add a short "voice" callout and a couple of before/after examples. Also patched a Python SDK snippet — consider showing `model_variant` in examples for clarity:
```python
client.generate(model_variant='gpt-redwood-v1', prompt='...')
```
Jordan (Eng-API): We can't change server API names in docs without a deploy. Server uses `model` as the query param. Proposal: keep API examples using `model` but add parenthetical "(aka model variant)" in prose and a glossary entry.
Maya (Docs): Drafted a glossary entry for mkdocs frontmatter, propose this YAML snippet: 
```yaml
- term: model variant
  aliases: ["variant", "flavor"]
  definition: "A specific build/quantization/configuration of a model served under a stable identifier. Prefer the term 'model variant' in user-facing docs."
```
Elaine (Docs): Two asks: (1) @Priya can you review the voice blurb in the PR? (2) @Jordan can you sign off on the "model (aka model variant)" phrasing so we don't imply API surface changes.
Priya (Product): Taking (1) — will add suggestions in the PR later today :eyes:
Jordan (Eng-API): I can sign off after a tiny wording tweak: prefer "model (server id) — aka model variant" so readers map it to the runtime identifier.
docs-ci (bot): Docs CI: build passed for PR #482 — 12 files changed, 3 warnings.
Sam (DevEx): Also idea: add a tiny migration table in the migration-guide showing "old phrasing -> canonical term" and a snippet that maps the SDK param name to the server param, e.g. `model -> model (aka model variant)`. I'll add a commit.
Maya (Docs): I'll add cross-links from the glossary to the SDK snippets and sweep pages to remove 'flavor' occurrences so it's consistent.
Elaine (Docs): Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll merge after Priya + Jordan approvals. If anyone wants to pair on wording, ping me. :sparkles:
